title: Claude app screens
summary: Full-screen app states. They read like a screen recording of the Claude app, so the result of a command can appear inside the chat.
usage: composer: {"piece": "overlays/composer", "theme": "ui/claude", "props": {"command": "/effects", "name": "glitch"}}. chat: {"piece": "overlays/chat", "theme": "ui/claude", "behind": true} with a layout card at x 30, y 545, 632 x 1125 for the result. prompt and worklog are floating cards for any footage storyboard: {"piece": "overlays/prompt", "theme": "ui/claude", "props": {"text": "Turn this into a reel", "y": 1150}}.

items.name: Composer
items.description: The composer with your clip attached: types the slash command with autocomplete, then the command's argument, presses the keys and sends (0.95 s). With "menu" ([[command, description], ...]) and "hold" the slash-command list shows first.

items.name: Chat, working
items.description: The chat after sending: your command as a pill, a spinning Claude spark with "Editing with <name>..." and SPED UP, and the reply bar. Put the clip in a card window over its dark card. With "reply" it is a plain answer that streams in word by word.

items.name: New chat, typing
items.description: A new chat: the spark and a greeting, a short message (a comment keyword) typed key by key and sent (0.95 s).

items.name: End card grid
items.description: Claude answers the keyword, a card resolves from a dot matrix of pixels popping in dim blacklight colours with little pixel mushrooms into a numbered grid of results (tiles: [{name, image}], more: N), then grows to full screen and holds (3.2 s).

items.name: Edited by Claude
items.description: A small translucent 'Edited by Claude' pill for a full-screen result (transparent around it).

items.name: Prompt box
items.description: The composer on its own as a floating card (transparent around it): the prompt types letter by letter with the orange caret, the send button presses, then the spark spins beside a short status line. Props: text, placeholder, status, typeAt, typeFor, sendAt, x, y, w, size.

items.name: Work log
items.description: Claude at work as a floating dark card: the spinning spark and a title, then the steps of the job; each lights up with a turning ring while it runs and gets an orange tick and its figure when done, over a progress line. Props: title, label, steps [{label, detail, at, doneAt}], doneAt, done, x, y, w, size. Give it real steps and figures.

items.name: Style scan
items.description: Claude learning a creator's style as a floating dark card: the user's reel covers stream in from both sides into the spinning spark, then at cardAt the card resolves into what it learned: colour swatches with hex codes, the user's fonts set in those fonts, and short facts (captions, pace). Props: images, colors [{hex, label}], fonts [{family, label}], facts [{label, value}], title, done, cardAt, x, y, w. Give it the user's real covers and style/profile.json; it invents nothing.

items.name: Claude Code terminal
items.description: Claude Code in a terminal window: `claude` is typed at a shell prompt and the welcome box opens, the request types into the input box and is sent (Claude starts working with the spark and a reply line), then a video file falls in and lands as an attachment chip. Props: command, file, reply, cwd, launchAt, typeAt, typeFor, sendAt, dropAt (seconds from the overlay start), x, y, w, size.

items.name: Claude agent rain
items.description: It rains little Claude agents: small clay-orange helpers (spark on top, two eyes, stubby legs) tumble down over the picture, near ones big and fast, far ones small and pale. Transparent. Props: count (34), speed (1), lead (s over which they enter, 0.25), size (1). For a 'Claude did it' moment.

items.name: Edit hook
items.description: Opening hook for a 'Claude edited this video' reel: a Claude Code status pill ('editing your video…') above the head; on slamAt the word slams in huge in ivory serif with a clay flash and shake and the pill flips to 'edited'; on burstAt a big Claude spark bursts behind the head; the tag types in in clay mono; the word slices into strips at wipeAt. Use two copies: layer 'back' (behind: person) and layer 'front'. Pair with a raw grade ending on slamAt. Props: layer, word, status, done, tag, slamAt, burstAt, tagAt, tagFor, wipeAt, y, size, pillY, burst {x,y,r}.
